answer: A taxi medallion with dispatch history is a regulated, audited identity. The applicant shows a city-issued medallion plus dispatch records covering hundreds of fares over a year. A medallion costs real money and every fare is logged by the dispatcher, so a farm would need a thousand licensed cabs for a thousand copies, while one honest driver shows the history they already have. The nectar of the work is the fare log itself, the dune of forged trips grows steeper with every copy, and the vertex where the cab waits is a real rank with real cameras.
